description: Original Cuttlefish Inkwell animated companion by Cozy Critters Studio, with a broad ivory oval mantle, continuous lavender-edged lateral fin, eight short arms and two retractable long tentacles. Nine original animation states use fin-powered swimming, a soft pattern-change display and gentle pearl handling; the jumping slot is a buoyant ascent-and-return. Original exploration, not a popularity claim.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
